almost_helpful_clerk_reassigned/start/am: Choose a card: in your next fight it is Redacted (its numbers are halved on its first play). Play it while Redacted and win that fight: it is permanently improved.
ammits_shadow/start/challenge: Your next ordinary fight adds Ammit's Shadow (90 HP, bites for 9 at the start of each of its turns). Win it: +60 Gold and a relic (Uncommon or Rare).
archive_window/start/method: Choose a card: it sits out your next fight and comes back improved. From then on it costs 1 less the first time you play it each fight.
inward_seal/start/outward: Gain the relic Inverted Sealstone · Choose 2 cards: in your next fight each is skipped on its first draw (Misfiled) and its numbers are halved on its first play (Redacted).
librarian_at_the_end_of_the_aisle/start/: Get back a card you removed, improved once more and carrying a True Name (once each fight, the first mark the archive puts on it is struck off again). If you have removed none: choose a Rare card of 3.
Your next ordinary fight: every enemy starts with 25% less HP, the fight pays no Gold, and you get an extra card reward.
licensed_vendor/start/browse: Opens the vendor's counter: 5 cards and 6 relics at shop prices, and a card removal for 75 Gold. Each item can be bought once.
lost_and_found_desk/start/identify: Choose a card: it sits out your next fight and comes back improved.
misfiled_prophecy/start/correct: Transform a card into a random card · Choose another card: in your next fight it is skipped on its first draw (Misfiled).
reciprocal_shelf/start/argue: Choose a card of 3 · Choose a card from your deck: in your next fight it is skipped on its first draw (Misfiled) and its numbers are halved on its first play (Redacted).
redacted_portrait/start/absent_name: Choose a card: for the rest of the run it carries a True Name. Once each fight, the first mark the archive puts on it is struck off again.
self_correcting_index/start/allow: Improve 2 cards · One improved card of your choice is Redacted in your next fight (its numbers are halved on its first play).
self_correcting_index/start/correct_your: Remove a card from your deck · Choose up to 2 cards: in your next fight each is skipped on its first draw (Misfiled).
the_buried_waystone/start/clean: Choose a card: for the rest of the run it is Stone-Witnessed. Once each fight, striking where you already struck this turn makes it deal a quarter more for the rest of that fight.
the_buried_waystone/start/follow: Your next ordinary fight: every enemy starts with 20% less HP, the fight pays no Gold, and you get a Rare card reward.
the_forewritten_tablet/start/demand_the_: Your next ordinary fight: every enemy gains 2 Strength and you start Burdened 1 (your next card costs 1 more). Win it: a relic (Uncommon or Rare).
the_tomb_robbers_fire/start/join_the_ope: Your next ordinary fight: every enemy gains 2 Strength and you start with 1 Panic (draw 1 fewer card). Win it: +120 Gold and a Common relic.
the_travelling_chandler/start/browse: Opens his cart: 3 cards and 2 relics, 20% below shop prices.
the_witch_at_the_milestone/start/shortes: Your next ordinary fight: every enemy starts with 20% less HP, the fight pays no Gold, and you get an extra card reward.
the_workers_bread/start/give_it_away: Gain a Feather of Truth: when Ammit would devour a card from your hand, she takes the Feather instead.
